title: SLASH · The card in the bag
venue: Box 4B · sixty pages · never lettered for print
logline: The Newport police's evidence room, through a window: a clear bag on a shelf with a single playing card in it, face out, a figure with a goat's head — no, a man in a good suit — the framer can't tell through two panes. He draws it both ways in the margin. The desk sergeant asks if he's family.

panels.composition: Full page: a wire-glass window into an evidence room, a shelf with a clear bag holding a single card face out, the card's figure ambiguous through the glass; in the page's margin two small sketches of the card, one a horned figure and one a man in a suit; a desk sergeant's shoulder at the frame's edge.
